system_prompt_style.evidence_quote: All prompts are stored as Markdown files external to the Python codebase, enabling rapid iteration and version control of agent behaviours without modifying application logic.
system_prompt_style.note: The orchestrator's system prompt is loaded from a Markdown file. Network state is appended to the specialist user message, not to the system prompt.

env_context_strategy.evidence_quote: This serialised state is appended to the user message sent to the agent
env_context_strategy.note: Closest value. The network state is a JSON object injected up front into specialist prompts; this is not a repository. Mismatch recorded.

context_compaction.note: Only the paper is available and it describes no compaction mechanism. No config surface exists in the evidence.

observation_format.evidence_quote: appends the specialist's response as an observation to the conversation history

tool_call_format.evidence_quote: The response is then parsed to detect action strings through pattern matching.
tool_call_format.note: Closest value. The action syntax is a text line of the form 'ACTION: CALL_AGENT | agent_name=... | request=...', parsed by pattern matching. It is not JSON.

tool_count.evidence_quote: available tools (call_agentfor specialist consultation andprovision_slicefor configuration ex- ecution)
tool_count.note: FINISH is an action string, not a tool.

edit_primitive.evidence_quote: available tools (call_agentfor specialist consultation andprovision_slicefor configuration ex- ecution)
edit_primitive.note: There is no file-editing tool; the domain is network configuration.

tool_schema_source.evidence_quote: The prompt includes a structured description of available tools

protocol_standardization.note: Paper only; there is no dependency list to check.

loop_primitives.evidence_quote: the system employs a sequential con- sultation protocol to resolve multi-domain constraints system- atically.
loop_primitives.note: The ReAct loop comes from Algorithm 1. The RAN-then-Core sequence is prompt-driven.

planning_granularity.evidence_quote: generating reasoning traces, executing tool calls, and refining its plan based on feedback.

multi_agent_topology.evidence_quote: an orchestra- tor agent coordinating two specialist agents

delegation_mechanism.evidence_quote: If the response containsACTION: CALL_AGENT, the system extracts the agent name and request, invokes functions to consult specialist agents
delegation_mechanism.note: Each specialist call is a fresh LLM call with its own system prompt.

human_in_loop.note: Paper only; no configuration surface is available.

short_term_state.evidence_quote: the orchestrator initialises a conversation history with two messages

long_term_memory.note: Paper only; no code is available to check.

state_persistence.note: Paper only; no code is available to check.

self_verification.evidence_quote: The orchestrator then aggregates the recommendations(r∗,b∗,c∗)and performs a final consistency check.

retry_policy.note: Paper only; no code is available to check.

rollback.note: Paper only; no code is available to check.

termination_condition.evidence_quote: with a maximum iteration limit of 10 to prevent infinite loops
termination_condition.note: The run also ends when the model emits ACTION: FINISH.

cost_controls.note: Token usage is tracked but no cap is described. Caching appears only as future work.

timeouts.note: Paper only; no code is available to check.

execution_isolation.note: Actions act on a mock JSON network state; no execution boundary is described.

filesystem_access.note: Paper only; no code is available to check.

network_policy.note: Paper only; no code is available to check.

permission_model.note: Paper only; no code is available to check.

tracing.evidence_quote: Token usage for each LLM call (both orchestrator and specialist invocations) is tracked and aggregated
tracing.note: The paper preserves reasoning traces; their format is unspecified.

replayability.note: Temperature 0 is claimed to give determinism, but no replay facility is described.

eval_hooks.note: A 12-scenario benchmark was used in the paper; there is no repo to check for a built-in runner.

guardrails.note: Paper only; no code is available to check.

target_domain.evidence_quote: translate natural language operational intents into executable net- work slice configurations
target_domain.note: The domain is telecom intent-based networking.

model_agnostic.note: Only Cerebras with Llama-3.3-70B is used; no client abstraction is described.

first_release_date.note: Date based on paper v1 as fallback.

pinned_version.note: No repo is available; the paper version is pinned instead.
